   470→    async def generate_inline_completions(
   471→        self, request: InlineCompletionRequest
   472→    ) -> InlineCompletionReply:
   473→        chain = self._create_completion_chain()
   474→        model_arguments = completion.template_inputs_from_request(request)
   475→        suggestion = await chain.ainvoke(input=model_arguments)
   476→        suggestion = completion.post_process_suggestion(suggestion, request)
   477→        return InlineCompletionReply(
   478→            list=InlineCompletionList(items=[{"insertText": suggestion}]),
   479→            reply_to=request.number,
   480→        )
   481→
   482→    async def stream_inline_completions(
   483→        self, request: InlineCompletionRequest
   484→    ) -> AsyncIterator[InlineCompletionStreamChunk]:
   485→        chain = self._create_completion_chain()
   486→        token = completion.token_from_request(request, 0)
   487→        model_arguments = completion.template_inputs_from_request(request)
   488→        suggestion = ""
   489→
   490→        # send an incomplete `InlineCompletionReply`, indicating to the
   491→        # client that LLM output is about to streamed across this connection.
   492→        yield InlineCompletionReply(
   493→            list=InlineCompletionList(
   494→                items=[
   495→                    {
   496→                        # insert text starts empty as we do not pre-generate any part
   497→                        "insertText": "",
   498→                        "isIncomplete": True,
   499→                        "token": token,
   500→                    }
   501→                ]
   502→            ),
   503→            reply_to=request.number,
   504→        )
   505→
   506→        async for fragment in chain.astream(input=model_arguments):
   507→            suggestion += fragment
   508→            if suggestion.startswith("```"):
   509→                if "\n" not in suggestion:
   510→                    # we are not ready to apply post-processing
   511→                    continue
   512→                else:
   513→                    suggestion = completion.post_process_suggestion(suggestion, request)
   514→            elif suggestion.rstrip().endswith("```"):
   515→                suggestion = completion.post_process_suggestion(suggestion, request)
   516→            yield InlineCompletionStreamChunk(
   517→                type="stream",
   518→                response={"insertText": suggestion, "token": token},
   519→                reply_to=request.number,
   520→                done=False,
   521→            )
   522→
   523→        # finally, send a message confirming that we are done
   524→        yield InlineCompletionStreamChunk(
   525→            type="stream",
   526→            response={"insertText": suggestion, "token": token},
   527→            reply_to=request.number,
   528→            done=True,
   529→        )
   530→
   531→    def _create_completion_chain(self) -> Runnable:
   532→        prompt_template = self.get_completion_prompt_template()
   533→        return prompt_template | self | StrOutputParser()

   667→        """Call out to Hugging Face Hub's inference endpoint.
   668→
   669→        Args:
   670→            prompt: The prompt to pass into the model.
   671→            stop: Optional list of stop words to use when generating.
   672→
   673→        Returns:
   674→            The string or image generated by the model.
   675→
   676→        Example:
   677→            .. code-block:: python
   678→
   679→                response = hf("Tell me a joke.")
   680→        """
   681→        invocation_params = self._invocation_params(stop, **kwargs)
   682→        invocation_params["stop"] = invocation_params[
   683→            "stop_sequences"
   684→        ]  # porting 'stop_sequences' into the 'stop' argument
   685→        response = self.client.post(
   686→            json={"inputs": prompt, "parameters": invocation_params},
   687→            stream=False,
   688→            task=self.task,
   689→        )
   690→
   691→        try:
   692→            if "generated_text" in str(response):
   693→                # text2 text or text-generation task
   694→                response_text = json.loads(response.decode())[0]["generated_text"]
   695→                # Maybe the generation has stopped at one of the stop sequences:
   696→                # then we remove this stop sequence from the end of the generated text
   697→                for stop_seq in invocation_params["stop_sequences"]:
   698→                    if response_text[-len(stop_seq) :] == stop_seq:
   699→                        response_text = response_text[: -len(stop_seq)]
   700→                return response_text
   701→            else:

   703→                # https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/main/en/package_reference/inference_client#huggingface_hub.InferenceClient.text_to_image.example
   704→                # Custom code for responding to image generation responses
   705→                image = self.client.text_to_image(prompt)
   706→                imageFormat = image.format  # Presume it's a PIL ImageFile
   707→                mimeType = ""

   710→                elif imageFormat == "PNG":
   711→                    mimeType = "image/png"
   712→                elif imageFormat == "GIF":
   713→                    mimeType = "image/gif"
   714→                else:
   715→                    raise ValueError(f"Unrecognized image format {imageFormat}")
   716→                buffer = io.BytesIO()
   717→                image.save(buffer, format=imageFormat)
   718→                # # Encode image data to Base64 bytes, then decode bytes to str
   719→                return (
   720→                    mimeType + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode()
   721→                )

This led to the prefix being repeated in the streamed inline suggestions. Fix implemented - I updated the server-side streaming logic to always apply post-processing on each streamed fragment, ensuring removal of spurious fragments and duplicated prefix consistently.
